pages.text: In old Witchery, the $(item)Rite of Summoning$() did not call an owl, toad, or cat that already lived in the world. It called a $(bold)Spectral Familiar$(/) instead: a ghostly companion whose purpose was to seek out shinies and strange things for its witch.$(br2)That is why the old rite text tells you to try giving the familiar a diamond.

pages.title: Current Port Truth
pages.text: Witchery: Rewoven now restores the separate $(bold)Spectral Familiar$(/) as its own bound summon instead of collapsing the rite into a Witch's Cat. The small-circle route, its real support offerings, and its altar cost are all back, and the familiar can once again be led toward shinies by feeding it the matching ore item.$(br2)The strongest current use is practical ore-hunting rather than combat.

pages.title: Searching for Ores
pages.text: Feed it an $(item)Iron Ingot$(), $(item)Gold Ingot$(), $(item)Lapis Lazuli$(), $(item)Redstone Dust$(), $(item)Coal$(), $(item)Emerald$(), or a $(item)Diamond$(). The gift is spent, the familiar starts searching, and if it finds the right ore somewhere below it will sit and call out the spot for you.$(br2)Like the old craft, repeated searches become risky: after the first success there is an increasing chance that the familiar will simply vanish.
